question: What is the antonym of "Reprobate"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Virtuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reprobate"** refers to a morally unprincipled person, someone who is wicked or sinful. (पथभ्रष्ट व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The city was full of reprobates who cared little about the law or morality.
 
 
• **"Virtuous"** refers to someone who is morally excellent, righteous, or exhibits high moral standards. (नैतिकतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** She led a virtuous life, always helping others and standing up for justice.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Reprobate'** is **'Virtuous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Virtuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rogue** (दुष्ट): A dishonest or unprincipled person.
 
 
• **Example:** He was known as a rogue trader who bent the rules for personal gain.
 
 
 
• **Unprincipled** (अनैतिक): Lacking moral principles or ethics.
 
 
• **Example:** Their unprincipled behavior led to the company’s downfall.
 
 
 
• **Rakish** (घमंडी): Displaying a carefree or self-indulgent attitude, often associated with stylish but morally dubious behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** His rakish charm made him popular despite his questionable lifestyle.
